title: In silico mutagenesis
lead: Mutates every base of a 2,000 bp sequence with Beluga and shows how each substitution changes one chromatin feature.

pairs.caption: Result map for HepG2 / CEBPB on the first sequence

differences.existing: Hidden field genome_assembly=hg19, no visible choice.
differences.proposed: No assembly field for FASTA; the job takes the model's first genome, hg19.
differences.evidence: Existing form inputs on /ism; VariantJobForm.tsx:60,102. Ask: does the API use the assembly for FASTA jobs at all?

differences.existing: Fills an editable text box with the example sequences.
differences.proposed: Shows a file card (example.fasta, 8.2 KB, 4 sequences, 2,000 bp each, ready to run). Not editable; Paste is a separate choice.
differences.evidence: Both forms after choosing the example option

differences.existing: Accepts any length. Warns that shorter sequences are padded with N on both sides and longer ones trimmed to the central 2,000 bp, then lets you submit.
differences.proposed: Blocks the run unless every sequence is exactly 2,000 bp.
differences.evidence: Pasted a 9 bp and a 2,200 bp sequence on both sites; VariantFileCheck.ts:100-110. Ask: should padding and trimming be kept?

differences.existing: Rule says A, T, C, G; lower case becomes upper case. Pasting XYZ or N showed no warning before submit.
differences.proposed: Lower case accepted; any other letter, N included, is flagged as not a base and blocks the run.
differences.evidence: Paste test on both sites; VariantFileCheck.ts:127-129. Ask: does the API accept N?

differences.existing: Lists each sequence and its length, such as s1 9 bp.
differences.proposed: Shows only a count, such as 2 lines need fixing; the per-line list appears only for uploaded files.
differences.evidence: Paste test on both sites; VariantJobForm.tsx:130 and 142

differences.existing: Collapsible Example files box inside the form, with one note covering Sei, Beluga and Seqweaver lengths.
differences.proposed: About panel beside the form with a Download link for example.fasta (2,000 bp for Beluga) and the docs link; FASTA rules in an accordion.
differences.evidence: Both form pages

differences.existing: An Opt-in to stay up to date with our newsletter checkbox appears once an email is typed.
differences.proposed: No checkbox on the form; the footer has a separate Release notes by email field.
differences.evidence: Typed an email on /ism; VariantJobForm.tsx:156

differences.existing: Submit, always active.
differences.proposed: Run in silico mutagenesis on 4 sequences; stays inactive until the file passes the checks.
differences.evidence: Both forms; VariantJobForm.tsx:72 and 158

differences.existing: None seen on the form or result page.
differences.proposed: Each started job is saved to this browser's Jobs list with title and sequence count.
differences.evidence: DeepseaForm.tsx:44

differences.existing: Opens on feature 0 (8988T / DNase) with no map; you pick a sequence and feature, then press Submit.
differences.proposed: Opens straight on HepG2 / CEBPB for the first sequence and reloads as soon as either choice changes.
differences.evidence: Both result pages for job 0576e894-a2c5-48bb-9bdf-227962495d5f; InsilicoResultView.tsx:19 and 63-67

differences.existing: Index: 297 | Cell type: HepG2 | Chromatin feature type: CEBPB | Treatment: None.
differences.proposed: HepG2 / CEBPB, with treatment in brackets only when there is one; no index, so 297 and 551 both read HepG2 / CEBPB.
differences.evidence: Existing feature list filtered by CEBPB; DeepseaResult.ts:119-121. Ask: is a short label fine, or is the index needed to tell duplicates apart?

differences.existing: Raw FASTA name; the axis shows positions in the sequence only.
differences.proposed: Name read as known_CEBP_binding_increase G>T, chr1:109,816,591-109,818,590; the side panel and table add the genome position of each base.
differences.evidence: Both result pages; InsilicoResult.ts:81-88 (relies on the name ending in _chr_start_end)

differences.existing: Continuous blue to white to yellow, legend -0.8 to 0.8; cells far past the legend show black.
differences.proposed: Seven steps, blue to orange, edges at 0.1, 0.25 and 0.5 either way, words Mutation lowers and Mutation raises.
differences.evidence: Both result maps; InsilicoResultView.tsx:20. Ask: where does the live -0.8 to 0.8 come from (the percentile field?) and what does black mean?

differences.existing: Log-fold change.
differences.proposed: Log2 fold change.
differences.evidence: Both legends. Ask: is the value log2?

differences.existing: A book icon beside the Log-fold change legend opens in-silico-mutagenesis.html#output.
differences.proposed: A Log-fold change score documentation link beside the controls opens the same page.
differences.evidence: humanbase.io deepsea bundle: the ISM heatmap legend links gY.ism.helpUrl#output with tooltip Log-fold change score documentation

differences.existing: A, G, C, T.
differences.proposed: A, C, G, T.
differences.evidence: Both result maps

differences.existing: About 100 bp around position 1,000 (axis 960 to 1040 on screen).
differences.proposed: 91 bp centred on the strongest substitution (positions 954 to 1,044 here), with a brush on the whole-sequence overview.
differences.evidence: Both result maps; InsilicoResultView.tsx:15 and 139-142

differences.existing: Hover tooltip with the raw value to six decimals, such as -0.059600.
differences.proposed: Clicking a position fills a side panel: genome position, reference base and each substitution's value to two decimals.
differences.evidence: Both result maps

differences.existing: None.
differences.proposed: Top 10 positions with genome position, strongest change, value and a Show button that moves the map there.
differences.evidence: Proposed result page; InsilicoResultView.tsx:167-194

differences.existing: Tool title and description only, plus Download CSV for the current choice.
differences.proposed: Job title, model, sequence count, length, submitted time, Copy link, Rename, Download results (the job's files) and Download CSV.
differences.evidence: Both result pages; InsilicoResultView.tsx:43-60

differences.existing: Asks the API with feature_name=297|HepG2|CEBPB|None.
differences.proposed: Asks with feature_name=297. Both returned data.
differences.evidence: Network requests on both result pages. Ask: is the index alone the supported form?
